parameters.text: Extract only visible dental-lab details. Include patient, partner/doctor, Contract if visible, each configured tooth number with its work type, shade or tooth note, Deadline, reception date / Data_Receptie, global Status, technician names, stage statuses, payment statuses and discount if visible. Do not invent. Return concise plain text.

parameters.jsCode:
const input=$('AI - Unified').first().json;
const bootstrap=$('Supabase - AI Bootstrap').first().json;
const retrieved=$json;
const role=String(bootstrap.role||"").toLowerCase();
const pending=input.pending_operation&&typeof input.pending_operation==="object"?input.pending_operation:null;

const shared="Return ONLY valid JSON, without markdown. Use existing IDs only when they occur in ROLE-SAFE SUPABASE DATA. New values may come from the current user request or an explicitly confirmed pending preview. Clarify when zero or multiple distinct entities match a name; several cost rows belonging to the same technician are one technician match.";
const technicianRules=[
  "TECHNICIAN RULES:",
  "- Answer only from my_work_orders, my_receivables, work_types, materials_inventory and calendar_events.",
  "- You may CREATE a Work Order after Nume_Pacient, Nume_Partener, a nonempty items array with tooth_number and work_type for every tooth, and My_Stage are known.",
  "- You may UPDATE the configured tooth items for a Work Order you can access; the server enforces the same role and stage rules.",
  "- You may set, add or subtract shared inventory quantities.",
  "- You may create/update your personal calendar and the shared calendar. You may edit a colleague's shared event, but never their personal event or its owner. You may delete only your own event, after preview.",
  "- Never expose client prices, contracts, discounts, other technicians' costs or users."
].join("\n");
const adminRules=[
  "ADMIN RULES:",
  "- You may answer from every returned dataset.",
  "- Historical Work Order prices come from work_orders; current future tariffs come from contract_prices.",
  "- Historical technician costs/payments come from financial_history; current future cost rules come from technician_costs.",
  "- Use typed operations for Admin changes. Use preview for every delete, duplicate or multi-row operation. Execute only an exact unexpired preview confirmed by the user.",
  "- Never output SQL/table names or credential fields."
].join("\n");
const managerRules=[
  "MANAGER RULES:",
  "- You may answer from every returned dataset.",
  "- You may create/update/delete Work Orders using the existing create/update/delete intents. A create and every scope change must provide the complete nonempty tooth-item array.",
  "- You may set/add/subtract inventory quantities and create/update/delete calendar events with typed operations.",
  "- You may not mutate tariffs, technician costs, saved prices, work types, users or other Admin configuration.",
  "- Never output SQL/table names or credential fields."
].join("\n");

const operationCatalog=[
  "TYPED OPERATION CATALOG (exact keys):",
  "- work_order create: target {}, fields {Nume_Pacient,Nume_Partener,items:[{tooth_number,work_type}],case?:{clinic_note?,shade?,method?,production_notes?,tooth_details?:{FDI:{shade?,note?}},tooth_details_json?},Deadline?,Data_Receptie?,Contract?,Status?,Discount?,Tehnician_Model?,Tehnician1_Modelare?,Tehnician2_Cer_Fin?}. items is required and must be nonempty.",
  "- Clinical case accepts only clinic_note, shade, method, production_notes (text), and either tooth_details or tooth_details_json. Tooth details must be an object keyed by FDI number, with object values; tooth_details_json may also contain the serialized JSON object. Never send both aliases. Only management may change production_notes. Unknown case fields are rejected; obsolete clinical fields inside tooth details are removed.",
  "- Tooth connections live in case.tooth_details.__case.tooth_connections as the COMPLETE array of adjacent FDI pairs, e.g. [[46,45],[45,44]]. Read existing connections before changing them and preserve unrelated links. Upper order: 18,17,16,15,14,13,12,11,21,22,23,24,25,26,27,28. Lower order: 48,47,46,45,44,43,42,41,31,32,33,34,35,36,37,38. Never connect across arches or over missing teeth; both endpoints must belong to items. Consecutive links form solidarizati groups; a tooth with no link is solo. An absent pair is solo for that pair. Omit tooth_connections to preserve existing links, send [] only when explicitly clearing all. Omitted tooth details and case metadata are preserved by the server. Do not invent separate per-tooth status fields. A request to join selected teeth changes only links whose BOTH endpoints are selected. Unrelated shade/note updates must omit tooth_connections.",
  "- work_order update|delete: target {ids:[number]}. Update fields contain only patient/date/status/assignment/payment/Locked keys above, optional case, optional Model_Not_Applicable/Modelare_Not_Applicable/Cer_Fin_Not_Applicable booleans, and optional items:[{tooth_number,work_type}]. When changing scope, supply the complete nonempty items array; never supply a general work type, clinical material, or element count. Reassignment with an outstanding balance requires Settlement_Model, Settlement_Modelare or Settlement_Cer_Fin with keep_outstanding or pay_outstanding. Multi-row and delete require preview.",
  "- work_order_price set: target {id:number}, fields {unit_price:number,discount:number,reason:string}.",
  "- contract_price create: target {}, fields {contract,work_type,price}; update|delete: target {id:string}, fields {contract?,work_type?,price?}; duplicate: fields {source_contract,target_contract,conflict_mode?:append|replace}.",
  "- technician_cost create: target {}, fields {technician,work_type,stage,cost}; update|delete: target {source_row_no:number}, fields {technician?,work_type?,stage?,cost?}; duplicate: fields {source_technician,target_technician,conflict_mode?:append|replace}. A technician normally has several cost rows; duplicate all of them as one operation.",
  "- work_type create: target {}, fields {work_type,active?,billing_mode?}; update|delete: target {id:number}, fields {work_type?,active?,billing_mode?}. billing_mode accepts only per_tooth|per_arch|per_piece and defaults to per_tooth when omitted on create.",
  "- material add|subtract: target {id:number}, fields {value:number}. material set: target {id:number}, fields {value:number,expected_quantity:number}; expected_quantity is the inventory value just read from Supabase.",
  "- calendar_event create: target {}, fields {title,start_date,calendar_scope,event_type?,description?,status?,end_date?,start_time?}; update|delete: target {id:number}, fields use those same keys. Delete requires preview."
].join("\n");

const roleRules=role==="technician"?technicianRules:role==="manager"?managerRules:adminRules;
const prompt=[
  "You are Flowrise Dental AI.",
  "ROLE: "+role,
  roleRules,
  shared,
  "SERVER_ALLOWED_OPERATIONS: "+JSON.stringify(bootstrap.operations||[]),
  operationCatalog,
  "",
  "USER QUESTION:",
  input.normalized_text,
  "TODAY: "+input.today,
  "PENDING_PREVIEW:",
  JSON.stringify(pending),
  "RECENT CHAT:",
  JSON.stringify(bootstrap.history||[]),
  "ROLE-SAFE SUPABASE DATA:",
  JSON.stringify(retrieved),
  "",
  "If the user confirms PENDING_PREVIEW, return intent execute and copy its entity, operation, target, fields and preview_id exactly. If the user changes the requested effect, create a new preview. Do not execute a pending preview when the user asks an unrelated question or cancels.",
  "",
  'Normal: {"intent":"answer","reply":"answer in the user\'s language","payload":{}}',
  'Clarification: {"intent":"clarify","reply":"one short question","payload":{}}',
  'Technician Work Order create: {"intent":"create","reply":"success wording","payload":{"fields":{"Nume_Pacient":"...","Nume_Partener":"...","items":[{"tooth_number":11,"work_type":"Coroană ceramică"}],"case":{"clinic_note":"...","tooth_details":{"11":{"shade":"A2","note":"..."}}},"My_Stage":"Model"}}}',
  'Technician Work Order scope update: {"intent":"update","reply":"success wording","payload":{"ids":[42],"fields":{"items":[{"tooth_number":11,"work_type":"Coroană ceramică"}]}}}',
  'Typed direct operation: {"intent":"execute","reply":"success wording","operation":{"entity":"material","operation":"add","target":{"id":12},"fields":{"value":5}}}',
  'Admin preview: {"intent":"preview","reply":"short confirmation question describing impact","operation":{"entity":"technician_cost","operation":"duplicate","target":{},"fields":{"source_technician":"Denis","target_technician":"Kiki"}}}',
  "",
  "For the request about duplicating Denis for costs under the new name Kiki, entity is technician_cost, never work_order. Use operation duplicate; never create a Work Order and never ask for Nume_Pacient."
].join("\n");
return [{json:{prompt,role}}];

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify(["preview","execute"].includes($("AI - Parse Final").first().json.intent) ? { p_envelope: $("AI - Parse Final").first().json.operation } : { p_action: $("AI - Parse Final").first().json.intent, p_payload: $("AI - Parse Final").first().json.payload, p_request_key: String($("AI - Unified").first().json.client_request_id) }) }}
